info.name: WattTime Get Grid Region from Location

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees.

params.name: signal_type
params.description: Signal type to check region availability for. Defaults to co2_moer.

items.docs: Identify the electric grid balancing authority or region for a given set of geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude). Returns the region identifier used in subsequent data requests.

info.name: WattTime Get Grid Region Boundary Maps

params.name: signal_type
params.description: Filter maps by signal type availability.

items.docs: Retrieve GeoJSON files showing the geographic boundaries of electric grid balancing authorities and grid regions accessible to the authenticated account. Useful for visualizing grid coverage areas on maps and verifying region boundaries.
